paper_title: Dark Matter Axion Search Using a Josephson Traveling Wave Parametric Amplifier
notes: Paper presents first JTWPA implementation in axion dark matter search. Exclusion bound stated as g_agamma > 10^-13 GeV^-1 over frequency range 4796.7–4799.5 MHz, corresponding to axion mass ~19.84 µeV (1.984e-5 eV). Figure 7 shows the exclusion limit plot with both DFSZ and KSVZ models. The limit assumes axion dark matter density of 0.45 GeV/cm^3 (equal to total dark matter density at Earth). Data acquired over ~2 weeks with 0.588-liter sidecar cavity. The narrow frequency range was due to a sticking tuning rod. Two-point encoding represents the vertical extent of the exclusion (from ~10^-13 to ~10^-9 GeV^-1 based on Figure 7) at the single measured mass of 19.84 µeV. | selector: text (sole candidate)
